excerpt: Nvidia posted a list of six supplier commitments this week, each attached to a capacity multiple. In the release, the company says substrate agreements with IBIDEN, Samsung Electro-Mechanics and Unimicron Technology Corporation will 'in aggregate, drive a 2.5x increase in capacity over the next three years.'
notes: AI Weekly summary of an NVIDIA release (published 2026-10-22). Names Ibiden and Nvidia in a substrate agreement; article also says Ibiden gets a multibillion-dollar advance to triple Ono Plant substrate capacity by Q1 2028. Secondary source; NVIDIA release not cached.
